scope.end_state: Lv20 plus repeatable Huaguoshan build and collection loop; this package does not grant entry to another chapter.

experience_policy.qualified_party_member_award: full personal base award once; party size never divides it
experience_policy.death_rule: no new live-combat XP while dead
experience_policy.reconnect_rule: the same authoritative receipt replays unchanged and cannot award twice

public_boss_policy.progression_participation: damage>=3% OR valid_break OR valid_guard OR valid_public_action
public_boss_policy.participation_chest: with an action window: valid_public_action AND (damage>=3% OR valid_break OR valid_guard); without one: damage>=3% OR valid_break OR valid_guard
public_boss_policy.rare_drop: separate authority-attested Boss-clear eligibility; chest result cannot imply it
public_boss_policy.pity: only a settled eligible rare-roll miss advances its own pool

team_raid_policy.participation: joined before lock AND present and alive at completion AND contribution-attested
team_raid_policy.rare_drop: qualified participation AND authority-attested team clear AND authority-attested personal rare eligibility
team_raid_policy.replay: the original character-owned reward receipt replays without changing resources, uniques, first clear, pity, or event origin

settlement_contract.replay: returns the original result without changing balances, uniques, first-clear state, or pity
settlement_contract.migration: not implemented here; live migration remains production-gated

first_five_build_milestones.condition: spend CUR_GOLD 60 and MAT_STRENGTHEN_SHARD 3 on HG_ENHANCE_T1

acceptance_criteria: all 20 level rows are continuous and reach Lv20 at 9485 XP
all 21 Huaguoshan reward profiles have an offline reward bundle
one named P1 conflict candidate is used only by the offline qualification and settlement simulation; it is not a final policy
chest, rare eligibility, and pity remain separate recorded results
HG_DROP_OX_RAID accepts only a correlated 1–4 member authority-attested team snapshot for its rare-roll and pity path
same receipt never applies a second XP, currency, unique, first-clear, or pity change
the scripted 0-360 active-minute trace reaches all five build milestones
the package contains no Y3 API calls and never claims a live map integration
